Answer: A
Reason: Figure 1b shows a dramatic rightward displacement and rotation of the cardiac silhouette into the empty right hemithorax compared to Figure 1a, which is diagnostic of right-sided cardiac herniation following pneumonectomy. This mechanical complication causes acute haemodynamic compromise by obstructing venous return and impairing cardiac output.
